headline: Amazon Violated Ontario Anti-Discrimination Laws by Rejecting Iranian Engineer
summary: An Ontario tribunal ruled that Amazon violated anti-discrimination laws by refusing to hire an Iranian engineer on a Canadian work permit due to U.S. export control rules and embargo policies.
why: Multinational hiring compliance policies that automatically filter candidates based on nationality must navigate conflicting local human rights legislation.

impacts.name: Amazon
impacts.why: Tribunal rulings can impose legal penalties and force changes to regional recruitment compliance frameworks.
